Air-Fryer Bang Bang Chicken

Juicy paprika-seasoned chicken with a creamy, sweet-chilli bang bang sauce. This lighter, protein-forward version swaps the Reel’s mayo-heavy sauce for tangy Greek yogurt.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
25 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
7

Ingredients

  • 600 g boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into strips
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp paprika
  • 1 tsp Sazon seasoning
  • Cooking spray
  • Lighter bang bang sauce: 170 g plain nonfat Greek yogurt, ¼ cup sweet-chilli sauce (reduced-sugar if you like), 1 tbsp sriracha, and 1 tsp lime juice
  • Spring onion or sesame seeds to finish (optional) (optional)

Amounts are scaled from 4 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Heat the air fryer to 390°F (200°C). Pat the chicken dry, then toss with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and Sazon.
  2. Arrange chicken in a single layer in the air-fryer basket and lightly spray with oil. Cook for 15–20 minutes, turning halfway, until browned and 165°F (74°C) in the thickest piece. Cook in batches if needed.
  3. While it cooks, whisk together Greek yogurt, sweet-chilli sauce, sriracha and lime juice. Taste and adjust the heat with more sriracha.
  4. Rest the chicken for 3 minutes. Serve with the sauce for dipping, or toss lightly to coat. Finish with spring onion or sesame if using.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
